[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Maximum Frequency Stack** [LC 895 · Maximum Frequency Stack](https://leetcode.com/problems/maximum-frequency-stack/){difficulty="Hard"}

Make the frequency an index: `levels[f]` is a stack of the values at the moment they *reached* frequency $f$. A value joins `levels[f]` exactly when its count becomes $f$, so the top of the highest non-empty level is the most frequent value and, among those, the newest. One integer `maxf` (the highest non-empty level) makes `pop` a single stack pop (@sec-ds-a3).

[Solved in full in @sec-ds-p3-freqstack.]{.card-link}

:::
